title: Alsace entity who said the witness had the time wrong and asked if this was Italy or Germany

tellings.quote: right then he says am I in Italy or Germany witness says you're in alzace

plain: A witness in Alsace, the French region on the German border, is said to have met a strange being that told him he had the time wrong and then asked him, "am I in Italy or Germany?" The witness answered, "you're in Alsace." The researcher Jacques Vallée tells the case to Michels as a summary, without naming his source or giving a date, as an example of the odd, almost absurd things such beings are reported to say.
